currentWork.title: FINAL.33 production verified; AN15 learned numeric promotion remains paused
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.33 is merged, deployed, and live-verified. The normal project state returns to the intentionally paused AN15 evidence/promotion gate.
releaseScope: Accurate GPS fixes with accuracy <=50m within 100m of the active route destination automatically end the in-app route.
Arrival shows exactly one visit card at a time: unvisited destination first, then other unvisited machines on today's plan within 100m.
Left swipe completes through the existing task and order confirmation flow; right swipe skips today's visit.
The standard Today list also supports right-swipe visit skip.
The blocking landscape portrait guard is withdrawn; normal app/MAP remain portrait-width and portrait is requested where supported.
Fullscreen MAP alone exposes a 🔄 software-rotation control for rotation-locked devices; PIN/modal interaction remains preserved.

productionEvidence.live: GitHub Pages version.json and public routing asset report 2026.10.07-FINAL.33; public UI contains 🔄 and bidirectional Today swipe labels

decision: Keep AN15 learned numeric promotion paused for now.
Do not add a new manual sales-outcome capture flow at this time.
Do not restore the withdrawn OCR/Analysis UI by assumption.
Do not weaken exact interval or no-lookahead safeguards merely to accumulate evidence.
Keep the deterministic production forecast baseline unchanged.
nextActions: Continue normal VENDRIVE use on FINAL.33.
If new real-device evidence reveals a defect or operator friction, open a new bounded maintenance scope with a new immutable pre-edit safety tag.
Revisit AN15 promotion only when an authorized real sales-outcome source becomes available or the user explicitly reopens the scope.

unresolved: AN15 learned numeric promotion is intentionally paused because normal shipped use does not provide the exact authorized real outcome evidence required for promotion.
